description: This file declares functions, enums, and constants related to registry-controlled domain processing, including effective TLD determination, domain extraction, and registry length calculations, used in network security and domain management within Chromium.

methods.name: GetDomainAndRegistry
methods.description: Returns the registered domain and registry information for a given URL, Origin, or host, based on effective TLD rules.

methods.name: SameDomainOrHost
methods.description: Checks if two URLs or Origins share the same domain or host.

methods.name: GetRegistryLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of the registry portion of a URL's host.

methods.name: HostHasRegistryControlledDomain
methods.description: Determines if a host has a registry-controlled domain.

methods.name: GetCanonicalHostRegistryLength
methods.description: Gets the registry length for a canonicalized host.

methods.name: PermissiveGetHostRegistryLength
methods.description: Gets the registry length for a host, allowing some invalid host formats.

methods.name: ResetFindDomainGraphForTesting
methods.description: Resets internal domain graph for testing purposes.

methods.name: SetFindDomainGraphForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom domain graph for testing.
